question: Refer to the exhibit. What is the outcome of this command when the EPLD is updated on a Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switch?
context: show install all impact epld bootflash:n9000-epld.6.1.2.I3.1.img
options: displays the compatibility of the EPLD upgrade and the image in the bootflash
shows a simulated upgrade of the EPLD
upgrades the EPLD on the switch disruptively
displays the impact of the upgrade on the operation of the switch
theory: "show install all impact epld <image>" is a non-disruptive, simulated check: it compares the running EPLD versions against the versions contained in the specified image and reports the compatibility and expected impact (disruptive or not, per module) of actually performing the EPLD upgrade — without making any changes yet. It is the pre-upgrade planning step, distinct from the command that actually performs the disruptive EPLD upgrade itself. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — EPLD Upgrade Impact)
